_note: Append new kits at the end only: a kit's position is its palette tile, which is what the map stores.
_note_kit: A kit is one plateau stamp read off a tileset. cols = [left cap, middle, right cap] tile columns; top = the row drawn on the plateau's top edge; middle = the repeatable surface row; face = the rows drawn BELOW the plateau (the wall), top to bottom. rim = pixels of drawn edge inside the top/left/right of a border cell, used for collision.
